name: Gokokuji
tagline: Shinjuku in 17 minutes and Otemachi in 17 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Bunkyo City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 17 minutes to Otemachi, 17 minutes to Shinjuku, 22 minutes to Shibuya and 35 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 13 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 19.7 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 13 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 13 m to 32.7 m, a difference of 19.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station, OpenStreetMap records neither a clinic nor a pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 小石川東京病院, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 都立大塚病院, about 14 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 東池袋→護国寺, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥250,000 to ¥260,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Shin-Otsuka; for safety, Gokokuji.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Gokokuji. Shin-Otsuka has the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, a different set from Gokokuji. To Tokyo, for instance, Shin-Otsuka is 8 minutes quicker. On how easy the shopping is, Shin-Otsuka comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Myogadani; for lower rent, Gokokuji.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Gokokuji. Myogadani has the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, a different set from Gokokuji. To Tokyo, for instance, Myogadani is 10 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥15,000 more at Myogadani.

People who want a park close by
People living alone who want to hold the rent down

People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
noiseSources: The 首都高速5号池袋線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
音羽通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 2 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
